title: FloodGuard Private Flood Policy — Cancellation Signature and Credit Posting
content:
## What the signature does

A FloodGuard Private Flood Policy is cancelled at the named insured's request by the named insured's own signature on the cancellation request already on file for the policy. The signature has three business effects at once:

- the cancellation request on file is marked completed;
- the policy becomes cancelled as of the cancellation date given, with the reason stated on the request recorded as the ground of the cancellation;
- the unearned-premium credit given — the cancellation credit — is posted to the policy's premium account, dated the day of signing.

After the signature the policy shows as cancelled and its premium account shows the cancellation credit.

## When the credit is worked out

The cancellation credit is worked out only after the premium account carries an additional-premium charge for every limit increase recorded on the policy with additional premium due.

Stated the other way round: while any limit increase recorded on the policy with additional premium due has no additional-premium charge of its own on the premium account, the cancellation credit is not yet worked out.

## Who runs it

`sign_flood_cancellation_83daa4cf` is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it: the signature on a cancellation belongs to the named insured alone.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `flood_policy_id` | The reference number of the FloodGuard flood policy record being cancelled, as read out by the representative from the flood policy lookup | Text identifier |
| `flood_request_id` | The reference number of the named insured's cancellation request on file, as read out by the representative from the request lookup | Text identifier |
| `cancellation_date` | The date the cancellation takes effect | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `credit_basis` | The basis of the credit | One of `pro_rata`, `flat`, `none` |
| `credit_amount` | The credit posted, in USD, as stated by the representative | Plain number with 2 decimal places; stored rounded half-up to 2 decimal places |

The values of `credit_basis` mean:

- `pro_rata` — the unearned share of the premium is returned for the days of the term beyond the cancellation date;
- `flat` — the whole term premium is returned because coverage is treated as never having started;
- `none` — no credit is posted because the premium is fully earned.

## Receipt

A completed signature returns `flood_policy_id` (the policy cancelled), `closed_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `credit_id` (the reference number of the credit entry), `credit_amount` (USD with 2 decimal places) and a status reading `policy_cancelled`, which means the cancellation was done.
